title: calculate_retirement_savings
description: Calculates retirement savings contributions, catch-up eligibility, and a projected balance at retirement. Returns monthly 401(k) and IRA contributions, employer match totals, tax implications (pre-tax vs Roth), and a year-by-year projection with compound growth.

age.description: Current user age in years. Age ≥ 50 enables 401(k) and IRA catch-up contributions.

years_to_retirement.description: Number of years until the user plans to retire. Used for balance projection.

filing_status.description: Federal filing status. Affects traditional IRA deductibility phase-outs.

state.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation or 'no_state_tax'. Used for net income calculations.

contribution_percent.description: 401(k) contribution as a percentage of gross salary (0–100). Ignored if max_out_401k is true.

max_out_401k.description: When true, contributes the IRS annual maximum to the 401(k) regardless of contribution_percent.

is_401k_roth.description: When true, treats the 401(k) as a Roth 401(k) (after-tax; no reduction to taxable income).

employer_match_percent.description: Employer 401(k) match as a percentage of gross salary (e.g., 3 for a 3% match).

employer_match_cap_percent.description: Cap on employer match as a percentage of gross salary. Employer will not match beyond this cap.

ira_contribution.description: Annual IRA contribution in USD. Cannot exceed IRS annual limit ($7,000; $8,000 age 50+).

ira_type.description: IRA account type. Traditional may be deductible (pre-tax); Roth is always after-tax.

assumed_annual_return.description: Assumed average annual investment return as a decimal (e.g., 0.07 for 7%). Used for balance projection only.

existing_retirement_balance.description: Current total retirement account balance in USD. Used as starting balance for projection.

catch_up_eligible.description: True if age ≥ 50 and eligible for catch-up contributions.

annual_catch_up_401k.description: Additional annual catch-up contribution amount (0 if not eligible).

total_monthly_retirement.description: Sum of employee 401(k), IRA, and employer match per month.

annual_pretax_deduction.description: Total annual pre-tax deduction reducing taxable income (traditional 401k + traditional IRA + HSA).

federal_tax_savings_annual.description: Estimated annual federal tax savings from pre-tax contributions.

traditional_ira_deductible.description: Whether the traditional IRA contribution is tax-deductible given income and filing status.

ira_phase_out_warning.description: Warning message if income is within or above the traditional IRA deductibility phase-out range, otherwise null.

projected_balance_at_retirement.description: Estimated total retirement balance at retirement, including compound growth.

projected_monthly_income_at_retirement.description: Estimated monthly income from retirement savings using the 4% safe withdrawal rule.
